classification: SUPERSEDE — the corrected figure is LARGER than the figure it replaces

corrected_measurement.rate_provenance: audio-and-stt.md, CUT30 era. NOT re-derived or negotiated for this corpus.
corrected_measurement.actual_spend: NOT YET OBSERVED — no request has been made. Forecast and actual stay separate.

root_cause_of_the_undercount.defect: The T7 aggregator classified 'MP4-only' at the FOLDER level, not the UNIT level.
root_cause_of_the_undercount.mechanism: A folder containing even ONE mp3 was treated as entirely mp3-served. The 113 mp4-only units distributed across otherwise-mp3 folders were therefore excluded from the total — they fell between both columns.
root_cause_of_the_undercount.direction: UNDERCOUNT. The true total cannot be lower; it was higher than reported.
root_cause_of_the_undercount.class: pipeline_defect — not a measurement, not a harness artefact. The probe was the bug.

independent_bound_that_confirms_the_corr.method: Sum every mp4 duration in the census as a raw lower-bound-free ceiling.
independent_bound_that_confirms_the_corr.check: 544.84 h (all mp4) + 47.90 h (the 15 mp3-only units that have no mp4) = 592.74 h — EXACTLY the manifest total.
independent_bound_that_confirms_the_corr.conclusion: The corrected figure is arithmetically saturated against the raw media set. It cannot be a double-count; a double-count would exceed 592.74 h.

duplicate_suppression_proof.claim: No unit is transcribed twice. MP3-only for paired units, per operator instruction 2026-10-14.
duplicate_suppression_proof.mechanism: The mp4 of a paired unit is RECORDED in the manifest but never SELECTED. A pipeline that downloaded 'all audio' would pull both encodings of all 70 paired calls; the manifest structurally cannot.
duplicate_suppression_proof.idempotency_requirement: Receipts key on stable call identity, never on a MEGA URL or expiring token, so a retried job skips completed calls instead of re-billing.

second_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessi.defect: build-manifest.py used a weaker normaliser than join-calls-v2.py
second_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessi.mechanism: An mp3 and its mp4 whose raw titles differ ('NHB Coaching Call - X.mp3' vs 'NHB+ Coaching Call - X.mp4') became TWO units.
second_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessi.observed_effect: 210 units / 634.67 h — a 21% overstatement against the measured 198 / 528.35 h
second_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessi.fix: Ported BRANDED_CALLTYPE / BARE_CALLTYPE / BRAND / date-zero-pad canonicalisation verbatim from join-calls-v2.py
second_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessi.note: This defect pointed the OPPOSITE way from the T7 one (overcount vs undercount). Their near-cancellation is why the intermediate figure looked plausible. Neither was found by inspection; both were found by checking a total against an independent bound.

third_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessio.defect: mega-cat returns nothing on a public link; WebDAV exposes the ACCOUNT, not public links
third_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessio.consequence: No route to per-file retrieval from a public MEGA link without staging the whole share.
third_defect_found_and_fixed_this_sessio.closes: GitHub Actions (14 GB runner vs 320 GB share). DEAD, structural.

operational_hazard_discovered.hazard: `timeout` does NOT stop a megacmd fetch.
operational_hazard_discovered.incident: A probe mega-get bounded by `timeout 45` continued server-side and had pulled 4.0 GB before it was noticed and killed.
operational_hazard_discovered.required_runner_control: Assert on disk after EVERY file and hard-stop on a threshold. Process timeouts are not a control for this. Verified the directory was removed; disk returned to baseline.

downstream_integrity.waiver_status: STALE. operator-decision-rule2-waiver-2026-10-14.json re-confirms Rule 2 at USD 136.31. Its own condition requires the conflict be re-recorded every run. At the corrected USD 152.93 that condition is NOT satisfied.
downstream_integrity.blocking: No spend is authorised until the waiver is re-confirmed at the corrected figure.
downstream_integrity.run_plan_status: probe/RUN-PLAN-nhbplus.md carries the superseded 528.35 h in sections 1, 4 and 5, and its section 5 scope table derives all three scope options from it. Every one of those rows is wrong and must be recomputed, not adjusted.
not_inferred: Per-file byte sizes remain ABSENT. Download volume is UNKNOWN, not small. The CDN URL's '/0-475' path segment encodes exact bytes; minting two URLs would measure the MP3:MP4 ratio. No download size may be quoted until then.
